Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Economy T-bills auction: Government records 22% undersubscription, but at lower interest rates Source : Joy Business 15 November 2026 11:14pm ▶ Listen to this article Audio By Carbonatix
The government recorded a 22% decline in its treasury bills target to GH¢4.33 billion.
According to the Bank of Ghana auction results, the auction target was GH¢5.57 billion, but the bids accepted by the government were GH¢3.4 billion, lower than the targeted amount.
A little over GH¢2.7 billion of the bids came from the 91-day bill, representing 63% of the total bids. The uptake was about GH¢2.51 billion.
The 182-day bill also received bids of about GH¢721.62 million. However, GH¢596.62 million was accepted.
About GH¢873 million of the bids were tendered for the 182-day bill. A little above GH¢344 million of the bids were accepted.
The yield on the 91-day bill declined by a basis point to 4.55%.
However, the 182-day bill declined by 4.0 basis points to 6.16% from the preceding week’s 6.20%.
Also, the yield on the 364-day bill eased by 2.0 basis points to 9.46%.
